content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing issues with my program—it starts but immediately shuts down, and I'm unsure how to resolve it. I'm on Windows 10 with the latest update installed, but the issue predates this update. Any suggestions that could help would be appreciated. Kind regards, [user_name]

That's quite unusual. Does no error message appear? You could try the following steps: 1) Reinstall [product_name] Soft Comfort, 2) Run as Administrator, 3) Launch the program in compatibility mode (e.g., Windows 7), 4) Disable antivirus software, 5) Reinstall Windows.
Are you sure you installed the correct version for your operating system—either 32-bit or 64-bit?

Is it possible that there's an issue related to "God Mode"? Some users have encountered problems with [product_name] Soft Comfort if a God Mode folder exists. Also, keep in mind that certain Windows updates, like the Creators Update, may cause Java crashes.
I believe I'm using the correct version.
I've tried all of these steps except for reinstalling Windows. I did perform a factory reset on my PC, and no warning appears. The program starts and then closes without any notification.
Last time I checked, my system was 64-bit, and the program is also the 64-bit version, so I don't think that's the issue.
Where can I locate the God Mode folder?
You need to search for it, possibly on your desktop or elsewhere.
I believe I found the God Mode folder—what should I do next?
Here's an excerpt from a topic in the German-speaking section of the forum.
The issue was indeed related to the God Mode folder. Thank you for your assistance. Greetings, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user reports that [product_name] Soft Comfort shuts down immediately after launching without any warning or error message, making troubleshooting difficult. Community members recommend standard troubleshooting steps, but the actual cause remains unclear until the God Mode folder is identified as the source of the problem. The absence of error details complicates the user's ability to resolve this issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] Soft Comfort to launch and run correctly on a compatible Windows 10 system and, at minimum, to provide clear error feedback if a problem prevents startup.
